title: Comments

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Comments explain a non-obvious decision instead of repeating the code, such as why a particular limit was chosen.
CORE EXPLANATION
A single-line comment starts with # and continues to the end of that line. Comments do not change program execution.

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: A name is not a copy of its value; mutations to a shared list or dictionary are visible through every alias.
COMMON MISTAKES
Distinguish a variable name, indentation, and comment: whitespace affects syntax, while comments explain intent.
